Package twoscilloscopeP5

Class XYPolyline

java.lang.Object
twoscilloscopeP5.XYPolyline
public class XYPolyline extends Object
A run of points, open or closed, standing in for openFrameworks' ofPolyline. Shapes go into XYscope as polylines (or PShapes) and come back out of XYDecoder and XYTransformer as polylines, in canvas pixels.

simplify() and getPerimeter() behave as ofPolyline's do, so decoding gives the same strokes as the openFrameworks addon.
